cohort: The study participants were neonates admitted to the intensive care unit in public hospitals in Mekelle city, Ethiopia.
finding: The leading causes of neonatal admissions were sepsis, RDS, MAS, and PNA, and Cesarean section, breastfeeding non-initiation within 1 hour, and neonatal resuscitation were associated with treatment outcome.
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery was identified as a factor associated with neonatal treatment outcome.
